required_draft_criteria.description: Walls, counters, chairs, workstations, floors, and camera can physically coexist.
required_draft_criteria.label: Room geometry

required_draft_criteria.description: Declared movement paths remain safe, visible, and unobstructed.
required_draft_criteria.label: Circulation

required_draft_criteria.description: Doors, walls, counters, windows, seating, and workstations remain stable.
required_draft_criteria.label: Spatial anchors

required_draft_criteria.description: A wide master establishes geography that all closer coverage preserves.
required_draft_criteria.label: Master and coverage

required_draft_criteria.description: Speaking principals remain identifiable and no person is duplicated or fused.
required_draft_criteria.label: Character count and identity

required_draft_criteria.description: Occupancy and crowd placement stay within the planned range.
required_draft_criteria.label: Background population

required_draft_criteria.description: Background people do not abruptly duplicate, disappear, intersect objects, or stare at the action.
required_draft_criteria.label: Crowd continuity

required_draft_criteria.description: Positions, scale, screen direction, and framing follow the shot plan.
required_draft_criteria.label: Blocking and framing

required_draft_criteria.description: Actors look at planned story targets and never into the camera.
required_draft_criteria.label: Gaze and eyeline

required_draft_criteria.description: Hands, feet, limbs, body contact, and object contact are plausible.
required_draft_criteria.label: Anatomy and contact

required_draft_criteria.description: Buttons, pockets, sleeves, closures, and accessories remain coherent.
required_draft_criteria.label: Wardrobe construction

required_draft_criteria.description: Props keep their shape, colour, owner, and planned location.
required_draft_criteria.label: Prop identity and ownership

required_draft_criteria.description: Handoffs and manipulation preserve physical contact and object identity.
required_draft_criteria.label: Prop interaction

required_draft_criteria.description: Protected identifiers, card faces, and monitor content remain unreadable.
required_draft_criteria.label: Privacy

required_draft_criteria.description: No malformed or unnecessary words, letters, numbers, signs, captions, or watermarks appear.
required_draft_criteria.label: Unwanted text

required_draft_criteria.description: Light direction, colour, and time of day remain coherent.
required_draft_criteria.label: Lighting continuity

required_draft_criteria.description: Facial performance and physical action fit the dialogue and dramatic beat.
required_draft_criteria.label: Performance and action

required_draft_criteria.description: Dialogue audio remains synchronized with its generated picture.
required_draft_criteria.label: Audio and lip sync

required_draft_criteria.description: Faces, wardrobe, location, props, narrative facts, and screen direction remain stable.
required_draft_criteria.label: Continuity

required_draft_criteria.description: Meaning comes from restrained light, colour, distance, architecture, and sparse text-free symbols.
required_draft_criteria.label: Symbolic environment

required_draft_criteria.description: The target occupancy is between 50% and 70%.
required_draft_criteria.label: Location occupancy

required_draft_criteria.description: No patient information is planned to be visible.
required_draft_criteria.label: Patient information policy

required_draft_criteria.description: The workstation monitor faces away from or is occluded from camera.
required_draft_criteria.label: Monitor orientation

required_draft_criteria.description: The counter maintains at least 0.8 metres between public and staff positions.
required_draft_criteria.label: Counter separation

required_draft_criteria.description: Location screens are never readable.
required_draft_criteria.label: Profile screen privacy

required_draft_criteria.description: Health-card faces are never readable.
required_draft_criteria.label: Profile card privacy

results.expected_condition: Faces, wardrobe, location, props, narrative facts, and screen direction remain stable.
results.observed_evidence: All deterministic storyboard, spatial, privacy, and continuity checks passed.
